title: CoP & VoP Scheme Readiness Self-Assessment
description: Self-assessment diagnostic scoring a PSP's own declared answers against the EPC Verification of Payee Scheme Rulebook (EPC218-23 v1.1, published 2026-03-16) and Pay.UK Confirmation of Payee obligations, plus a separately-scored, clearly-flagged track for CoP-enhancement capabilities (multi-name matching, richer mismatch metadata) reported in industry PSP pilots ahead of a formal Pay.UK v2.0 publication. Produces a gap report and Policy Mandate.

mcp_tool_definition.name: assess_cop_vop_scheme_readiness
mcp_tool_definition.description: Scores a PSP's self-declared answers against the EPC VOP Scheme Rulebook (EPC218-23 v1.1) and Pay.UK Confirmation of Payee obligations, including a separately-tracked CoP-enhancement pilot checklist, and returns a gap report. Self-assessment only, not a scheme compliance determination.
